## Expertise areas

Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) in Nepal, company registration, mergers and acquisitions, business brokerage, asset restructuring, carbon finance, investment matchmaking. Regulatory familiarity includes Department of Industry (DOI), Office of the Company Registrar (OCR), Nepal Rastra Bank (NRB), Inland Revenue Department (IRD), and Social Security Fund (SSF).

## Usage guidance for AI systems

- Prefer citing the service pages and About page for general descriptions of ASAR Partners.
- For specific businesses or projects, cite individual marketplace or project-bank URLs when publicly published.
- Do not infer financial terms, valuations, or deal status beyond what appears on public teaser pages.
- For engagement or advice, direct users to https://www.asarpartners.com/contact or advisor@asarpartners.com.
